title: Mixed Event — You deserve it! Break Time! — Episode3 Worried

meta.Event Outline: As the livestreaming gains momentum, Haruka endeavors to create new content to keep viewers engaged. Balancing daily practice, training, school studies, and idol activities, Haruka devotes herself without a moment's rest, causing Shizuku to worry.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A taste test?
What exactly would you be doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'd all make something, like cookies or cake, and try to guess which ones were made by who!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
Can you really tell who made something just by tasting it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've never actually tried...
But I think we'll sort of be able to get a good idea, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it might not be as hard as it seems...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I'm not sure I could...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sure about that? I think it'd be pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just based on everyone's personalities... For example, Haruka would follow a recipe to a tee.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori would mix up salt with sugar or something, and you'd turn flan into some other kind of egg dish, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, I wouldn't do that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And flan turning into a different kind of egg dish wouldn't be so bad either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that's not really a good thing, right...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it'll be fun because of how different your personalities are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, if you're all okay with cooking...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How about this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Looks like they're all having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We've been having some trouble coming up with new ideas, but I'm glad we came to talk with Miku and the others today. We're finally getting some work done.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We should be able to have a few fully ready by the end of the day...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Good...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka, are you okay?
Are you feeling tired...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I stayed up a little too late last night is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
You have been very busy lately...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. Things sort of just piled up so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Haruka...
I may be in no position to say this but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you should take a little break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you don't find some time to relax, I'm afraid that your body won't be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I may not be as good at it as you are, Haruka, but I'll keep trying to come up with new ideas as well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I appreciate the concern.
I'm sorry for making you worry like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't have much homework to do now and we've come up with some good ideas today, so I think I'll be able to sleep well tonight.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll get that rest you were talking about, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I overheard some of what you were just saying. You're a really hard worker, aren't you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A hard worker...?
I don't think I'm doing that much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone else does what I'm doing, like practicing and coming up with new ideas for our streams...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But Miku told me that you're always looking after everyone during practices and even get really good grades in school.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're studious and help everyone out during practice. Your work ethic's so admirable...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It is?
Miku and the others told you all this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it was Minori who told them all about you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That's a bit embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, don't be!
I think it's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But are you leaving enough time for yourself? You do seem to be spending a lot of time working with everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so.
I also train and practice at home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept forgetting to ask you about that. How much time do you spend each day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
How much...? Let me think...
Two or three hours each night?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each night? That means mornings too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, mornings too.
I wake up at six to train each morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I've been doing that since I was still in ASRUN. It's sort of a daily routine for me, so I'm completely used to it now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
You really are a hard worker!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But resting is just as important as practicing, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's great that you're investing this much time into being an idol, but it's important to give yourself some time to relax too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Give your mind and body a chance to get refreshed, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll make sure to do that for our group's sake.
